what_works: Gallery format where individual artist work is the focus, framed in editorial spacing — refined elegance through restraint, not embellishment. Photography is treated as the content, not decoration.
what_does_not_translate: Pure gallery format expects browsing intent; for contractors, lift the editorial framing of individual work pieces (each project as a curated gallery item, not a thumbnail).
type_observations: Restrained serif/sans pairing — type recedes so photography commands. Captions sit small and clean below each work.
